item.title: Heber City’s gluten-free food wagon is open for business
item.description: Providing peace of mind to those with celiac disease is just one reason the Pettits opened their gluten-free food truck, Family Food Wagon. They even had the truck custom-made instead of buying a used one to ensure that there would be zero chance of cross contamination.
